newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabian monetary agency governor warns public against dealing with unlicensed investment advisors.
- Saudi Consolidated Electricity Company signs contracts worth $309 million with Saudi and joint venture firms for linking second Ghazlan steam power plant to the main system.
- Jeddah municipality earns around 117 million riyals from lease agreements offered to the private sector.
- One killed, three injured as a group of 14 people tried to enter the country illegally by land.
- Industry and electricity minister approves 59 new projects with combined capital of 1.8 billion riyals.
- Al-Zamil Group and the U.S. Great Lakes Chemical Corp to set up a joint venture plant in Saudi Arabia at a cost of 110 million riyals.
